title: Treatment points on Wear OS watch show at bottom of graph.
symptom: With 'Show Treatments' enabled under 'Android Wear Integration', finger stick treatment points appear at 0 on the vertical axis of the watch graph, causing the graph to always range down to 0 instead of zooming to the target range.
evidence_quote: the finger sticks are at 0 on the vertical axis. The graph would normally zoom in on the target range, unless there are low or high values, but the finger sticks cause it to always range all the way down to 0.
